# Interview Sarthi

> InterviewSarthi is three apps for job seekers: Apply Sarthi finds jobs and helps fill applications (always free), Prep Sarthi runs spoken mock interviews from your CV (free 7-minute demo, no sign-up, works on a phone), and Live Sarthi shows answer suggestions during interview calls on Windows (30 minutes free). The homepage at https://interviewsarthi.com/ explains all three. Paid passes are one-time and never renew. Prices are given in rupees for India and in US dollars for everyone else. Built and run by Abhishek Choudhary. Facts reviewed 25 September 2026.

Product and guide pages contain readable HTML. Interactive app features require JavaScript. Facts pages carry review dates and a corrections address.

## The three products

- [Apply Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/apply/): Web app at https://apply.interviewsarthi.com/ plus a Chrome extension. Brings together jobs from Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, Foundit, Shine, Internshala and company career pages, matches them to your CV, tailors your CV for a job and fills supported application forms for you to review and submit. Always free, with no paid plan. Browsing jobs and your first tailored CV need no Gemini key; further tailoring uses your own free key. Best for: finding Indian and remote jobs that fit your CV.
- [Prep Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/): Web app for phones and computers, at https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/app/. An AI interviewer asks spoken questions built from your CV and the job you want, follows up on weak answers, and writes a report with a score, what was missing and a stronger answer for each question. Free 7-minute demo interview with no sign-up and no key. Then one-time passes: 7 days Rs 99 (USD 4.99) or 30 days Rs 249 (USD 9.99), unlimited mock interviews; after buying, you add your own free Google Gemini key in a one-minute setup. Company practice pages: TCS NQT, Infosys, Cognizant GenC, Capgemini. Best for: rehearsing out loud before a real interview.
- [Live Sarthi](https://interviewsarthi.com/live/): The Interview Sarthi Windows app (Windows 10 version 2004 or later, Windows 11), from the Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NMKQPSQ1KS8. It hears interview questions on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet and other call apps and drafts answer suggestions from your CV, in English, Hindi or Hinglish. Its panel is hidden from supported screen sharing. Answers start in about 1.5 seconds; timing varies. Uses your own free Gemini key. 30 minutes free per device, then one-time passes: 2 days Rs 99 (USD 9.99), 7 days Rs 399 (USD 19.99), 30 days on 2 devices Rs 999 (USD 39.99), 90 days on 2 devices Rs 1,999 (USD 69.99). A pass's days start when you activate its key, not when you pay; 7-day money-back on a first pass. Use assistance only where interview rules permit it.

- [Resume-based mock interview walkthrough](https://interviewsarthi.com/prep/mock-interview-from-resume.html): CV and job-description setup, spoken practice and how to use feedback.
- [Public job directory](https://apply.interviewsarthi.com/jobs): job details, company pages and role categories; availability changes as employers update listings.
